content:
maria: Heads-up — running a routing-fallback simulation tomorrow at 08:00 PT to exercise backfill/recompute surge behavior. Goal: validate canary fallback weights + quota autoscaling. Need sign-off on throttle params and what telemetry we must surface.

ajay: thanks — +1. can we run it against staging first and use a synthetic tenant so we don't touch prod quotas?

maria: yes staging first. plan is: 1) start small replay workload, 2) nudge fallback routing to prefer cheaper model variant, 3) ramp to expected surge and observe per-tenant quota bleed.

sasha: I want a safe kill-switch. If cross-tenant quota > 80% we should abort. Also we must ensure console shows quota burn in realtime.

ajay: agreed on kill-switch. Suggest we use `fallback_weight` param and a controlled window in the routing policy: `window_ms: 30000, max_switches: 2` — toggle to cheaper model after X failures.

ajay: snippet for the sim job (staging):
```
POST /replay/run
{
  "tenant_id": "staging-sim-42",
  "rate": 200, // rps
  "duration_s": 600,
  "payload_profile": "kv-heavy",
  "tag": "routing-fallback-sim"
}
```

olga: telemetry checklist from my side: prefix_cache_hit_rate, per-model p50/p95 latency, route_switch_count, quota_consumed/sec, backfill_surge_gauge. We should add a panel for "fallback-induced latency" that correlates route_switch_count with p95.

maria: perfect. can you also add an alert for route_switch_count spike (>200/min) and for quota_consumed/sec crossing the canary threshold?

olga: will do. I'll put dashboards in a new folder `playbooks/routing-sims`.

sasha: console UX ask — show a compact banner when a tenant is in simulated fallback mode with a link to the simulation run id so SREs can drill into traces.

jack: note — Dedicated pools may throttle differently than hosted. Add a `pool_override` header to the sim to cover both code paths. Otherwise we miss a surge profile.

ajay: good catch. add `X-Pool-Override: dedicated-us-west` to one of the runs.

maria: schedule: staging run tomorrow 08:00 PT, brief postmortem at 10:00 PT. If staging looks good, we can mirror a limited prod run on Friday in a canary lane (10% tenants).

sasha: who owns the abort? ops oncall or platform?

jack: platform will own the sim routine, ops will own the kill confirmation in prod. ops-bot will post job status.

ops-bot: replay-runner: job 20240315-874 started (staging-sim-42) — running 200rps for 600s. Link: https://ci/replay/20240315-874

maria: thanks. last ask — ajay, can you add a CLI flag to the sim to throttle token generation per-tenant so we can emulate uneven tenant distributions?

ajay: on it. `--tenant-burst-profile` will accept `uniform|hotspot|zipf` and default to `uniform`. I'll push a branch and tag it in the run.

olga: dashboards and alerts created, IDs: dash-PLAT-812, alert-PLAT-921. Linking in the run notes.

sasha: :thumbsup: OK let's keep communication tight during the run — #eng-oncall and #eng-platform will be bridged.

maria: awesome. thanks everyone — see you in the postmortem.
